finding: Large language models (LLMs) are neural network models trained on massive text corpora to perform natural language processing tasks such as generation, summarization, translation, and analysis.
LLMs are typically based on the transformer neural network architecture, which uses self‑attention mechanisms to process sequences in parallel and scale effectively with data and compute.

LLMs can suffer from biased or inaccurate outputs due to training data quality; benchmark evaluations focus on reasoning, factual accuracy, alignment, and safety, and tool‑harnesses can add memory and external capabilities.

Anthropic operates as a public benefit corporation emphasizing AI safety and public good, whereas OpenAI is a capped‑profit (for‑profit) company focused on broad AI advancement and commercial product releases.
